products.name: Captions AI
products.note: AI video editing; eye contact correction; dubbing; likeness manipulation consent

profile_text.body:
Captions is an AI video generator and editor founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York City. The company describes itself as a tool that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content regardless of a user's editing skill level, positioning its AI as understanding story context and tailoring edits to specific footage rather than applying uniform automated changes.

The company's primary product, Captions AI, covers a range of video editing and generation capabilities including automatic scene cutting, B-roll overlay, caption generation, translated subtitles, and dubbing. The platform also supports the creation of AI avatars and what the company calls an "AI twin," allowing users to generate new footage without recording, and to iterate across different videos using the same digital likeness. The site notes that likeness manipulation involves consent considerations, and use cases listed include ads, social media videos, product demos, tutorials, and real estate listing videos.

The held facts note 185 instances of legal exposure associated with New York, though no specific cases are recorded in the available data.
